name: Rixden Quote Builder
author: Rikus Rossouw

sections.description:
Rixden Quote Builder is a visual quote request system for any WordPress site selling services, products, or both. Clients browse your catalogue with beautiful cards, add items to their quote, and submit a detailed request — all without leaving your page. No more generic contact forms or “request a quote” links that go nowhere.

Built for trades, agencies, caterers, consultants, event planners, rental businesses, studios, fitness coaches, cleaning services, beauty salons, photographers, landscapers, moving companies — any business where pricing depends on what the client actually wants.

Mobile Front-end Video Demo

https://youtube.com/shorts/VQ1AKXzMn3k

How it works

  1. Add categories for your offerings (e.g. Services, Packages, Products)
  2. Add items to each category with title, description, price, unit label, and image
  3. Optional: enable a flat delivery fee and set a free-delivery threshold in Settings
  4. Paste the [rixden_quote_builder] shortcode onto any page
  5. Clients browse, tap to add items with a quantity, and submit their quote
  6. You receive a notification email; the client receives a confirmation

Features

  • Visual, Uber Eats style product browsing
  • Unlimited categories and products
  • Horizontal category filter pills with drag-to-scroll and fade edges
  • Grid view and list view toggle on desktop and tablet
  • Two-column grid on mobile for compact browsing
  • Product detail modal with image, description, and quantity selector
  • Floating quote summary panel (sticky on desktop, slide-up drawer on mobile)
  • Live count badges on cards showing what’s in the quote
  • Quote persists across accidental page refresh (cleared when tab closes)
  • Optional flat delivery fee with configurable label (Delivery Fee, Shipping, Service Fee, etc.)
  • Free delivery threshold — fee is automatically waived when quote subtotal reaches a configurable amount
  • Product sorting by price or name
  • Quote request form with name, email, phone, and notes
  • Spam protection via honeypot
  • HTML confirmation email to the client, branded with your accent colour
  • HTML notification email to admin with full quote breakdown
  • Admin dashboard with Dashboard, Categories, Products, Quote Requests, and Settings tabs
  • Admin product search and category filter
  • Quote status management — New, Reviewing, Quote Sent, Closed
  • Mobile hamburger navigation in admin
  • Fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile
  • Inherits your theme’s font family
  • Customisable accent colour, currency symbol, page title, and thank you message
  • Built-in support and documentation tab
  • WordPress.org compliant — no tracking, no third-party scripts, no data collection

Shortcodes

  • [rixden_quote_builder] — full shortcode
  • [rixden_qb] — short alias with identical behaviour

Pro Version

Rixden Quote Builder Pro adds the complete quote-to-paid workflow on top of the free plugin:

  • Send official branded PDF quotes directly from your dashboard
  • Clients accept or decline via a secure hosted link — no login required
  • Auto-generated invoices when you mark a quote as paid
  • Edit quotes — adjust line items, prices, add discounts and markups
  • Discount and markup lines (fixed or percentage) on quotes, PDFs, and emails
  • Quote and invoice reference numbers (Q-2026-0001 / INV-2026-0001 format)
  • Quote request reference numbers (QR-2026-0001) generated on submission
  • Configurable quote expiry dates with automatic expiry notification email
  • Two automated follow-up reminder emails with customisable timing and templates
  • Customisable email templates for every client touchpoint with merge tags
  • Email branding — logo, custom footer, full colour theming
  • Full business profile on PDFs — address, VAT number, company registration
  • Tax support — VAT, GST, Sales Tax, or any custom label and rate
  • Payment URL (Stripe, PayPal, etc.) or written bank transfer instructions per quote
  • Adaptive post-acceptance messaging based on your payment configuration
  • Per-quote payment URL override for exact-amount payment links
  • Internal admin notes per quote (not visible to clients)
  • Min and max quantity limits per product (enforced on the frontend)
  • Sent Quotes dashboard with clickable status filter cards
  • Invoice dashboard with revenue stat cards — Total, This Year, This Month, Last 30 Days
  • Create and send custom quotes directly from your admin dashboard
  • Seamless upgrade from free — all data preserved automatically
  • Priority email support

External Services

This plugin does not connect to or rely on any third-party or external services. All data is stored locally in your WordPress database. No data is transmitted to external servers.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/rixden-quote-builder, or install through the WordPress Plugins screen
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu
  3. Navigate to Quote Builder in the WordPress admin sidebar
  4. Create your categories on the Categories tab
  5. Add your products or services on the Products tab
  6. Paste [rixden_quote_builder] on any page or post where you want the builder to appear

The plugin also includes a Support tab in the admin with step-by-step setup help and common questions.
sections.faq:
Does this require WooCommerce or any other plugin?

No. Rixden Quote Builder is completely standalone. No WooCommerce, no page builder, no dependencies.

Can I use this for physical products, not just services?

Yes. The builder works for any priced item — services, products, packages, rental gear, catering menus, consulting hours, event bookings. Whatever you sell, list it as a product.

What happens if a client refreshes the page mid-quote?

Their selections are preserved in the browser session, so an accidental refresh won’t wipe their quote. The quote clears when they close the browser tab.

How do I add a delivery or shipping fee?

Go to Quote Builder → Settings, scroll down to the Delivery Fee section, enable the toggle, and enter your flat fee. You can also set a free-delivery threshold so the fee is waived when the quote subtotal reaches a certain amount. The label is fully customisable — use “Delivery Fee”, “Shipping”, “Service Fee”, or anything that fits your business.

Can I use my own currency?

Yes. Go to Quote Builder → Settings and enter any currency symbol you want.

How do clients receive confirmation?

Immediately after submitting, they receive a clean HTML email with their full quote summary, branded with your accent colour and company name.

Where do quote requests go?

All quote requests appear in the Quote Requests admin tab with full client details, items, quantities, totals, and a status dropdown so you can track progress.

Is the shortcode safe to use in Gutenberg / Elementor / Divi / Classic Editor?

Yes. The shortcode works anywhere standard WordPress shortcodes work, including Gutenberg shortcode blocks, Classic Editor, and all major page builders.

Where can I upgrade to Pro?

See the Pro Features tab in the admin dashboard for a full feature list and upgrade link.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Fix: Theme compatibility — category filter pills, sort button, and other UI text no longer inherit uppercase or capitalize transforms from themes that force them globally.
  • Fix: Theme compatibility — product modal, quote submission modal, sort modal, and quote drawer no longer get trapped behind theme headers, sticky navbars, or logos on themes that use CSS transforms or stacking contexts on parent containers.
  • Improved: Tested up to WordPress 7.0.

1.0.0

  • Initial release
